blurb: A focused six-fact drill set for Artificial Intelligence, Data, Cloud, Automation, Robotics and Biometrics.

topics.title: Artificial intelligence
topics.hook: Artificial intelligence develops systems that perform tasks associated with human reasoning, perception, or language.
topics.explainer: Artificial intelligence develops systems that perform tasks associated with human reasoning, perception, or language. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Artificial Intelligence, Data, Cloud, Automation, Robotics and Biometrics

connections.fact: Machine learning is one major approach used to build AI systems, but AI also includes rule-based reasoning and other techniques.
Robots use sensors and actuators; AI can help them perceive surroundings, plan actions, and adapt.

topics.title: Machine learning
topics.hook: Machine learning improves a model's performance from data instead of only fixed hand-written rules.
topics.explainer: Machine learning improves a model's performance from data instead of only fixed hand-written rules. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Artificial Intelligence, Data, Cloud, Automation, Robotics and Biometrics

connections.fact: Machine learning improves behaviour from data and is a subset of the broader goal of artificial intelligence.
Modern generative AI models are trained with machine-learning methods to learn patterns and produce new outputs.

topics.title: Cloud computing
topics.hook: Cloud computing provides on-demand network access to shared computing resources such as servers and storage.
topics.explainer: Cloud computing provides on-demand network access to shared computing resources such as servers and storage. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Artificial Intelligence, Data, Cloud, Automation, Robotics and Biometrics

connections.fact: Cloud platforms rent the processors, storage, and deployment services used to train or serve many generative AI systems.
A biometric application may send encrypted face or fingerprint features to cloud services for storage or matching, raising security and privacy concerns.

topics.title: Robotics
topics.hook: Robotics combines mechanical engineering, sensors, and software to build machines that act in the physical world.
topics.explainer: Robotics combines mechanical engineering, sensors, and software to build machines that act in the physical world. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Artificial Intelligence, Data, Cloud, Automation, Robotics and Biometrics

connections.fact: Robotics supplies physical sensors and actuators, while AI can supply perception and decision-making.

connections.relationship: Learning from sensor and action data
connections.fact: A robot can use machine learning to recognise objects or improve control from examples rather than fixed rules alone.

topics.title: Biometrics
topics.hook: Biometrics verifies identity through physical or behavioural traits such as fingerprints, faces, or iris patterns.
topics.explainer: Biometrics verifies identity through physical or behavioural traits such as fingerprints, faces, or iris patterns. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Artificial Intelligence, Data, Cloud, Automation, Robotics and Biometrics

connections.fact: Many face, voice, and iris systems use trained models to compare a presented sample with stored biometric features.
Biometric recognition can use AI, but biometrics specifically concerns measurable human traits used for identity.

topics.title: Generative AI
topics.hook: Generative AI creates new text, images, audio, or code by modelling patterns in training data.
topics.explainer: Generative AI creates new text, images, audio, or code by modelling patterns in training data. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Artificial Intelligence, Data, Cloud, Automation, Robotics and Biometrics

connections.fact: Generative AI is built with machine-learning models that estimate patterns in training data and sample new content.
Cloud computing supplies accelerators and elastic capacity for training and serving large generative models.

topics.explainer: AI > ML > deep learning. Supervised uses labels; unsupervised finds structure; reinforcement learning uses rewards. Classification predicts classes; regression predicts values. Overfitting means poor generalisation. Precision concerns predicted positives; recall concerns actual positives. Transformer = attention. GPT = Generative Pre-trained Transformer. RAG retrieves. Fine-tuning changes weights. Hallucination means unsupported generation.

questions.q: Which description is broad enough to cover reasoning, perception, and language tasks performed by machines?
questions.explanation: Artificial intelligence is the umbrella field; machine learning, language systems, and rule-based reasoning are approaches or applications within it.

questions.q: What distinguishes machine learning from a system made only of fixed hand-written rules?
options: It improves a model using data
It must use a physical robot
It stores files in the cloud
questions.explanation: Machine learning estimates patterns from examples or feedback so performance can improve without specifying every decision rule manually.

questions.q: A startup rents servers for one week and releases them after a traffic spike. Which model is this?
questions.explanation: Elastic, on-demand access to shared servers and storage is a defining cloud-computing capability.

questions.q: Which combination is most characteristic of robotics?
options: Mechanical structures, sensors, and control software
Cameras, labels, and a static image archive
questions.explanation: A robot couples physical mechanisms and actuators with sensing and software so it can act in the real world.

questions.q: Which identifier is biometric rather than something a user knows or carries?
questions.explanation: An iris pattern is a measurable physical trait; passwords are knowledge factors and tokens are possession factors.

questions.q: A model produces a new image from a text prompt. Which AI category best fits?
questions.explanation: Generative AI learns distributions in training data and creates new text, images, audio, video, or code from prompts.

options: Artificial intelligence is only a branch of biometrics
Machine learning is a method within AI
Cloud computing is a subfield of robotics
Generative AI contains the entire field of machine learning
questions.explanation: Machine learning is one route to artificial intelligence; the two terms overlap but are not interchangeable.

questions.q: A spam filter changes after learning from labelled messages. What is doing the learning?
questions.explanation: Learning from labelled examples to classify later messages is supervised machine learning, even if the model runs in the cloud.

questions.q: Which statement corrects the claim that every robot is intelligent?
options: Physical automation can follow fixed control rules without AI
Every robot must adapt its behaviour by learning from data
A machine becomes a robot only when it uses generative AI
Remote control alone proves that a robot reasons autonomously
questions.explanation: Robotics concerns machines acting physically; some use AI for perception or planning, while others execute predetermined control sequences.

questions.q: Why is cloud computing often paired with large generative models?
options: It supplies scalable processors and storage
It supplies all training data automatically
It removes the need for model optimisation
questions.explanation: Cloud platforms make costly accelerators and elastic deployment capacity available without each user owning a data centre.
